rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE1:
FROM  ( SELECT o.*, rr.*, dbo.repgettext( 'BZEQDL', R5_LANG, 
CASE WHEN OBJ_RELIABILITYRANKING IS NULL THEN 70 
WHEN OBJ_RRVALUESLASTCALCULATED IS NULL THEN 69 
WHEN COALESCE( RRK_SETUPLASTUPDATED, OBJ_RRSURVEYLASTUPDATED ) IS NULL THEN 69 
WHEN dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( OBJ_RRVALUESLASTCALCULATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI' ) < 
dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( CASE WHEN RRK_SETUPLASTUPDATED IS NULL THEN OBJ_RRSURVEYLASTUPDATED 
WHEN OBJ_RRSURVEYLASTUPDATED IS NULL THEN RRK_SETUPLASTUPDATED 
WHEN dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( RRK_SETUPLASTUPDATED,  'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI' ) < 
dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( OBJ_RRSURVEYLASTUPDATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI' ) THEN OBJ_RRSURVEYLASTUPDATED 
ELSE RRK_SETUPLASTUPDATED END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI' ) THEN 69 
ELSE 70 END ) as OUT_OF_SYNCH
FROM   R5OBJECTS o
LEFT JOIN  R5RELIABILITYRANKINGS rr
ON         rr.RRK_CODE = o.OBJ_RELIABILITYRANKING
AND        rr.RRK_ORG = o.OBJ_RELIABILITYRANKING_ORG
AND        rr.RRK_REVISION = o.OBJ_RELIABILITYRANKINGREV ) t
WHERE   1 = 1
rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE2:
AND     OBJ_OBRTYPE IN ('A', 'S', 'P' )
AND     OBJ_ORG IN (
        SELECT  UOG_ORG
        FROM    R5USERORGANIZATION,
                R5PERMISSIONS
        WHERE   UOG_USER = R5_USER
        AND     UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP
        AND     PRM_FUNCTION = R5_FUNC
        AND     UOG_ROLE = R5_ROLE
        AND     PRM_SELECT = '?'
        )
AND  (( 'OFF' = (
        SELECT  INS_DESC
        FROM    R5INSTALL
        WHERE   INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC' )
        ) OR
        EXISTS (
        SELECT 'X'
        FROM   R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY
        WHERE  DSE_USER = R5_USER
        AND    DSE_MRC = OBJ_MRC )
        )
AND   ( SEL_PARAM1  = '%' OR OBJ_ORG    LIKE SEL_PARAM1 )
AND   ( SEL_PARAM2  = '%' OR OBJ_CODE   LIKE SEL_PARAM2 )
AND   ( SEL_PARAM3  = '%' OR OBJ_MRC    LIKE SEL_PARAM3 )
AND   ( SEL_PARAM4  = '%' OR OBJ_STATUS LIKE SEL_PARAM4 )
AND   ( SEL_PARAM5  = '%' OR OBJ_OBTYPE LIKE SEL_PARAM5 )
AND   ( SEL_PARAM6  = '%' OR OBJ_CLASS  LIKE SEL_PARAM6 )

AND ( SEL_PARAM2 = '%' OR WSS_RTYPE LIKE SEL_PARAM2 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM3 = '%' OR WSS_PARTNER LIKE SEL_PARAM3 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM4 = '%' OR WSS_REQ_RSTATUS LIKE SEL_PARAM4 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM5 = '%' OR WSS_DOCUMENT LIKE SEL_PARAM5 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM6 = '%' OR WSS_CORRELATIONID LIKE SEL_PARAM6 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM7 = '%' OR WSS_CONTEXTID LIKE SEL_PARAM7 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM8 = '%' OR WSS_RSP_DOCUMENT LIKE SEL_PARAM8 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM9 = '%' OR WSS_RSP_RSTATUS LIKE SEL_PARAM9 ) AND (( SEL_PARAM10 = 'MT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ) OR  ( SEL_PARAM10 = 'LPT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_REQ_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_REQ_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ) OR  ( SEL_PARAM10 = 'LDT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RSP_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RSP_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ) OR  ( SEL_PARAM10 = 'NRT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RETRY_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RETRY_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 )) AND ( SEL_PARAM1 = '%' OR WSS_ORG LIKE SEL_PARAM1 )

AND ( SEL_PARAM2 = '%' OR WSS_CODE LIKE SEL_PARAM2 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM3 = '%' OR WSS_RTYPE LIKE SEL_PARAM3 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM4 = '%' OR WSS_PARTNER LIKE SEL_PARAM4 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM5 = '%' OR WSS_REQ_RSTATUS LIKE SEL_PARAM5 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM6 = '%' OR WSS_RSP_RSTATUS LIKE SEL_PARAM6 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM7 = '%' OR WSS_DOCUMENT LIKE SEL_PARAM7 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM8 = '%' OR WSS_CORRELATIONID LIKE SEL_PARAM8 ) AND ( SEL_PARAM9 = '%' OR WSS_CONTEXTID LIKE SEL_PARAM9 ) AND (( SEL_PARAM10 = 'MT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ) OR  ( SEL_PARAM10 = 'LPT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_REQ_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_REQ_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ) OR  ( SEL_PARAM10 = 'LDT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RSP_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RSP_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ) OR  ( SEL_PARAM10 = 'NRT' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RETRY_TIME, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), WSS_RETRY_TIME, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 )) AND ( SEL_PARAM1 = '%' OR WSS_ORG LIKE SEL_PARAM1 )

AND (SEL_PARAM3 = '%' OR key_accesslevel LIKE SEL_PARAM3 )

FROM (select	NCF_CODE, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG, 'NOCF', NCF_CODE, NULL, NULL) AS NCF_DESC, NCF_ORG, 
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_PK ELSE NULL END AS NCO_PK,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_OBSERVATION  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_OBSERVATION, 
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG,'UCOD',NCO_STATUS,'NOST', null) ELSE NULL END AS NCO_STATUS,
	NCF_OBJECT, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG, 'OBJ', NCF_OBJECT + '#' + NCF_OBJECT_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS EQU_DESC, NCF_OBJECT_ORG, 
	NCF_LOCATION, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG, 'LOC', NCF_LOCATION + '#' + NCF_LOCATION_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS LOC_DESC,NCF_LOCATION_ORG,
	NCF_PART, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG, 'PART', NCF_PART +'#' + NCF_PART_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS PART_DESC, NCF_PART_ORG,
	NCF_NCTTYPE, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG, 'NOCT', NCF_NCTTYPE + '#' + NCF_NCTTYPE_ORG, NULL, NULL) AS TYPE_DESC,NCF_NCTTYPE_ORG,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_TASK  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_TASK,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_TASKREV  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_TASKREV,
	NCF_SYSLEVEL, NCF_ASMLEVEL,NCF_COMPLEVEL, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG, 'CLVL', csr_code, csr_rentity, NULL) AS EMRS_DESC,
	NCF_MATLTYPE, dbo.repgetdesc(R5_LANG,'UCOD',NCF_STATUS,'NCST', null) AS NCF_STATUS, NCF_PRIORITY, 
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_NOTE  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_NOTE,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_SEVERITY  ELSE NCF_SEVERITY END AS NCF_SEVERITY,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_INTENSITY ELSE NCF_INTENSITY END AS NCF_INTENSITY,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN dbo.repfmtnumlocale(R5_USER, R5_ORG, NCO_SIZE)  ELSE dbo.repfmtnumlocale(R5_USER, R5_ORG, NCF_SIZE) END AS NCF_SIZE,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_IMPORTANCE  ELSE NCF_IMPORTANCE END AS NCF_IMPORTANCE,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_RECORDEDBY  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_RECORDEDBY,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_RECORDED  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_RECORDED,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_CONDITIONSCORE  ELSE NCF_CONDITIONSCORE END AS NCF_CONDITIONSCORE,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_CONDITIONINDEX  ELSE NCF_CONDITIONINDEX END AS NCF_CONDITIONINDEX,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_NEXTINSPECTDATE  ELSE NCF_NEXTINSPECTDATE END AS NCF_NEXTINSPECTDATE,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_NEXTINSPECTDATEOVERRIDE  ELSE NCF_NEXTINSPECTDATEOVERRIDE END AS NCF_NEXTINSPECTDATEOVERRIDE,
	NCF_RECOMMREPAIRDATE, NCF_ESTLABORCOST, NCF_ESTMATLCOST, NCF_ESTMISCCOST,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_WORKORDER  ELSE NULL END AS NCO_WORKORDER,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_CREATEDBY  ELSE NCF_CREATEDBY END AS NCF_CREATEDBY,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_CREATED  ELSE NCF_CREATED END AS NCF_CREATED,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_UPDATEDBY  ELSE NCF_UPDATEDBY END AS NCF_UPDATEDBY,
	CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 ='+'  THEN NCO_UPDATED  ELSE NCF_UPDATED END AS NCF_UPDATED
rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE2:
FROM r5nonconformities 
left outer join r5nonconformitytypeemrs 
     on ncf_ncttype = nte_nonconformitytype_code 
     and ncf_ncttype_org = nte_nonconformitytype_org 
     and ncf_syslevel = nte_syslevel 
     and coalesce(ncf_asmlevel, '') = coalesce(nte_asmlevel, '') 
     and coalesce(ncf_complevel, '') = coalesce(nte_complevel, '') 
left outer join r5nonconformobservations
on ncf_sourceobservation = nco_pk
INNER JOIN r5userorganization  ON ncf_org = uog_org AND uog_user = R5_USER AND uog_role = R5_ROLE INNER JOIN r5permissions on prm_function = R5_FUNC and uog_group = prm_group and prm_select = '?'
left outer join r5codestructure 
          ON RTRIM(csr_strlevel1) = COALESCE(RTRIM(nte_syslevel), RTRIM(ncf_syslevel))
     AND COALESCE(RTRIM(csr_strlevel2), 'IAMNULL') = COALESCE(RTRIM(nte_asmlevel), RTRIM(ncf_asmlevel), 'IAMNULL') 
     AND COALESCE(RTRIM(csr_strlevel3), 'IAMNULL') = COALESCE(RTRIM(nte_complevel), RTRIM(ncf_complevel), 'IAMNULL')
WHERE (SEL_PARAM1 = '%' OR ncf_org LIKE SEL_PARAM1 OR CHARINDEX(ncf_org + ',', SEL_PARAM1 + ',' ) > 0) 
AND (SEL_PARAM2 = '%' OR ncf_code LIKE SEL_PARAM2 OR CHARINDEX(ncf_code + ',', SEL_PARAM2 + ',' ) > 0) 
AND (SEL_PARAM3 = '%' OR ncf_status LIKE SEL_PARAM3 ) 
AND (SEL_PARAM4 = '%' OR (( SEL_PARAM11 = '+' AND nco_status LIKE SEL_PARAM4 ) OR ( SEL_PARAM11 = '-' ) )) 
AND (SEL_PARAM5 = '%' OR ncf_object LIKE SEL_PARAM5 ) 
AND (SEL_PARAM6 = '%' OR ncf_ncttype LIKE SEL_PARAM6 ) 
AND (SEL_PARAM7 = '%' OR (CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 = '+' THEN nco_severity ELSE ncf_severity end LIKE SEL_PARAM7 )) 
AND (SEL_PARAM8 = '%' OR (CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 = '+' THEN nco_intensity else ncf_intensity end LIKE SEL_PARAM8 ))  
AND (SEL_PARAM9 = '%' OR ( SEL_PARAM11 = '-' and dbo.REPFMTNUM(R5_USER, CAST(ncf_size as NVARCHAR(100))) = dbo.REPFMTNUM(R5_USER, CAST(SEL_PARAM9 as NVARCHAR(100))))
OR ( SEL_PARAM11 = '+' and dbo.REPFMTNUM(R5_USER, CAST(nco_size as NVARCHAR(100))) = dbo.REPFMTNUM(R5_USER, CAST(SEL_PARAM9 as NVARCHAR(100)))))
AND (SEL_PARAM10 = '%' or (CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM11 = '+' THEN nco_importance else ncf_importance end like SEL_PARAM10 ))
AND ( ( 'OFF' = ( SELECT UPPER( ins_desc ) FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = 'DEPTSEC' ) ) OR ( ( 'ON' = ( SELECT  UPPER( ins_desc ) FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = 'DEPTSEC' ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = R5_USER AND dse_mrc = NCF_MRC ) ) )
) subquery

AND ( ( 'OFF' = ( SELECT UPPER( ins_desc ) FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = 'DEPTSEC' ) ) OR ( ( 'ON' = ( SELECT  UPPER( ins_desc ) FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = 'DEPTSEC' ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = R5_USER AND dse_mrc = OBJ_MRC ) ) )

rows.RFN_FROMCLAUSE: FROM R5ORDERS LEFT OUTER JOIN R5ORDERLINES ON ORD_CODE = ORL_ORDER AND ORD_ORG = ORL_ORDER_ORG LEFT OUTER JOIN R5TRADES ON ORL_TRADE = TRD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN R5ADDRESS ON ORD_SUPPLIER + '#' + ORD_SUPPLIER_ORG = ADR_CODE AND ADR_RENTITY = 'COMP' AND ADR_RTYPE = 'M', R5COMPANIES
rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE1: WHERE ORD_SUPPLIER = COM_CODE AND ORD_SUPPLIER_ORG = COM_ORG
rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE2: AND ORD_ORG LIKE SEL_PARAM1  AND  ORD_CODE LIKE SEL_PARAM2  AND ORD_STATUS LIKE SEL_PARAM3  AND (SEL_PARAM4 = '%' OR ORD_CLASS LIKE SEL_PARAM4 ) AND (SEL_PARAM5 = '%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ORD_DATE, 101), 1, 10)  = SEL_PARAM5 ) AND ORD_SUPPLIER LIKE SEL_PARAM6  AND (SEL_PARAM7 = '%' OR ORD_CODE IN (SELECT ORL_ORDER FROM R5ORDERLINES WHERE ORL_PART LIKE SEL_PARAM7 )) AND (SEL_PARAM8 = '%' OR ORD_CODE IN (SELECT ORL_ORDER FROM R5ORDERLINES WHERE ORL_TRADE LIKE SEL_PARAM8 )) AND (SEL_PARAM9 = '%' OR ORD_CODE IN (SELECT ORL_ORDER FROM R5ORDERLINES, R5CATALOGUE  WHERE CAT_SUPPLIER = ORD_SUPPLIER AND CAT_SUPPLIER_ORG = ORD_SUPPLIER_ORG AND CAT_PART = ORL_PART AND CAT_PART_ORG = ORL_PART_ORG AND CAT_REF LIKE SEL_PARAM9 )) AND (SEL_PARAM10 = '%' OR ORD_CODE IN (SELECT ORL_ORDER FROM R5ORDERLINES WHERE SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ORL_DUE, 101), 1, 10) = SEL_PARAM10 )) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS WHERE UOG_USER = R5_USER  AND UOG_ORG = ORD_ORG AND UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND PRM_FUNCTION = R5_FUNC AND uog_role = R5_ROLE AND PRM_SELECT = '?') AND (SEL_PARAM11 = '%' OR ORD_CODE IN (SELECT ORL_ORDER FROM R5ORDERLINES WHERE SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ORL_DUE, 120), 1, 10) >= SEL_PARAM11 )) AND (SEL_PARAM12 = '%' OR ORD_CODE IN (SELECT ORL_ORDER FROM R5ORDERLINES WHERE SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ORL_DUE, 120), 1, 10) <= SEL_PARAM12 ))

rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE1:
FROM (SELECT E.EVT_OBJCRITICALITY EVT_OBJCRITICALITY,
E.EVT_ORG EVT_ORG, 
E.EVT_MRC EVT_MRC,
SUM((CASE WHEN (E.EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ISNULL(E.EVT_TARGET, ISNULL(E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE)),120),1,10) < 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM4   = '%' THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE SEL_PARAM4   END) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) START_BACKLOG, 
SUM((CASE WHEN (E.EVT_RSTATUS = 'R' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ISNULL(E.EVT_TARGET, ISNULL(E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE)),120),1,10) >= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM4   = '%' THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE SEL_PARAM4   END)  AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ISNULL(E.EVT_TARGET, ISNULL(E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE)),120),1,10) <= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM5   = '%' THEN '2099-12-31' ELSE SEL_PARAM5   END) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) RECEIVED_WO,
SUM((CASE WHEN (E.EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ISNULL(E.EVT_TARGET, ISNULL(E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE)),120),1,10) < 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM4   = '%' THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE SEL_PARAM4   END)  AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) >= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM4   = '%' THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE SEL_PARAM4   END) AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) <= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM5   = '%' THEN '2099-12-31' ELSE SEL_PARAM5   END) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) COMPLETED_WO,
rows.RFN_WHERECLAUSE2:
SUM((CASE WHEN (E.EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ISNULL(E.EVT_TARGET, ISNULL(E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE)),120),1,10) >= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM4   = '%' THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE SEL_PARAM4   END)  AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) >= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM4   = '%' THEN '1900-01-01' ELSE SEL_PARAM4   END)  AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),ISNULL(E.EVT_TARGET, ISNULL(E.EVT_REPORTED, E.EVT_DATE)),120),1,10) <= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM5   = '%' THEN '2099-12-31' ELSE SEL_PARAM5   END)  AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) <= 
(CASE WHEN SEL_PARAM5   = '%' THEN '2099-12-31' ELSE SEL_PARAM5   END) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) COMPLETED_RECEIVED_WO 
FROM   R5EVENTS E ,R5OBJECTS
WHERE  E.EVT_OBJECT = OBJ_CODE
AND    E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG=OBJ_ORG
AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM R5USERORGANIZATION U, R5PERMISSIONS P 
               WHERE  U.UOG_ORG = E.EVT_ORG AND U.UOG_USER = R5_USER 
               AND P.PRM_FUNCTION = R5_FUNC AND U.UOG_GROUP = P.PRM_GROUP AND uog_role = R5_ROLE AND P.PRM_SELECT = '?')  
AND E.EVT_RTYPE  IN ('PPM','JOB')
AND E.EVT_JOBTYPE <> 'MEC'
AND (E.EVT_ORG     LIKE SEL_PARAM1  ) 
AND (ISNULL(OBJ_CLASS,'%') LIKE SEL_PARAM2  ) 
AND (ISNULL(E.EVT_OBJCRITICALITY,'%') LIKE SEL_PARAM2 )
GROUP BY  E.EVT_OBJCRITICALITY ,E.EVT_ORG ,E.EVT_MRC ) WZMEWC  WHERE 1=1

AND (SEL_PARAM2 = '%' OR evt_code LIKE SEL_PARAM2 OR CHARINDEX(evt_code + ',', SEL_PARAM2 + ',' ) > 0

AND (SEL_PARAM6 = '%' or EVT_PERSON like SEL_PARAM6 )
AND (SEL_PARAM7 = '%' OR EVT_SCHEDGRP LIKE SEL_PARAM7 ) 
and (SEL_PARAM8  = '%' or evt_priority  = SEL_PARAM8 )
AND (SEL_PARAM9 = '%' OR EVT_PPM LIKE SEL_PARAM9 ) 
AND (SEL_PARAM10 = '%' OR EVT_LOCATION LIKE SEL_PARAM10 )
